title: Table Poet: November mail club, paper textures and micrographics
note: Paper texture and micrographics inspo. Stop-motion of Table Poet's November mail club, reposted by @rawartstudio from @tablepoet: a periwinkle envelope ('From one Table, To another') opens onto layered translucent and off-white papers, a typewritten welcome letter, flower-shaped drink collars in maroon stripes and pale blue ('The Confessional'), a receipt-style 'Cherry Matcha Latte' recipe with tiny ingredient lists and dotted leaders, a collectible sticker card with small circles, and handwritten script signatures. Each envelope holds a letter, 3 drink collars with writing prompts, 3 drink recipes, a sticker card and a sticker (per the caption). 13 s clip with sound. Thumbnail is a frame from the clip.
